summary: Sihanouk International Airport (KOS/VDSV) is the main gateway to Cambodia's premier coastal destination, Preah Sihanouk (Sihanoukville), serving the country's stunning Gulf of Thailand beaches and islands. Located approximately 20 kilometers southeast of the city center, the airport has undergone modernization to accommodate growing tourism to Cambodia's southern coast. It primarily handles domestic connections to Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, along with select international routes from regional Asian carriers.
faqs:
Q: How far is Sihanouk International Airport from Sihanoukville city center?
A: The airport is roughly 20-25 kilometers from the downtown area, typically a 30-45 minute drive depending on traffic and road conditions.

Q: What airlines operate from Sihanouk International Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by Cambodia Angkor Air and other regional carriers for domestic routes, with occasional international charter and scheduled services from nearby Asian countries.

Q: Are there ATMs and currency exchange at the airport?
A: Yes, basic banking facilities and ATMs are available in the terminal, though it is advisable to carry some US dollars or Cambodian riel as backup since services can be limited.

Q: Is there a left luggage facility at KOS?
A: Luggage storage options at the airport are limited; travelers are generally better off arranging storage through their hotel in Sihanoukville.
transport_tips: Taxis and tuk-tuks are available outside the terminal for the journey into Sihanoukville, but agree on a fare before departing as meters are rarely used. Shared minivans can be arranged through guesthouses and offer a budget-friendly option to nearby beaches. For Phnom Penh connections, direct bus services often provide door-to-door convenience that may be preferable to flying the short distance.
local_tip: Many guesthouses and hotels in Sihanoukville offer free or low-cost airport pickup if you book directly rather than through third-party sites—just ask when you make your reservation.
